semantic.justification: Task76 general-copy progress ports original CopyCellsFromClipHandler and CopyTextAttrsFromClipHandler with real typed source blocks,two content/metadata passes,independent native cursor values,context writeback and foreign string re-interning. ScColumn scalar/hinted SetValue/SetRawString/SetFormulaCell overloads retain native defaults,return contracts,broadcast controls and actual group/listener owners. Table2 CopyFromClip validates/clamps the destination and dispatches actual source columns;CONTENTS preserves destination patterns and geometry. ParseBlock now represents its actual container-event template and borrowed node fields;bounded ProcessFormula dispatches real formula pointers and separate non-formula spans. Original column/table/document SetDirtyFromClip,rectangular individual/area BroadcastCells and deferred BroadcastAction use existing bulk owners and actual subscriptions;cached formula results are dirtied only in completion. Matrix,foreign-pool formulas,number-format inheritance,full formatter/notes/edit/drawing services,group-compute cache invalidation and shell/UNO stream notifications remain unrepresented. Native general document/reference orchestration,paste undo/redo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance remain pending;this is not full task76 acceptance or full parity. Task76 conditional-index binding ports document/table/column/ScAttrArray AddCondFormatData/AddCondFormat over the actual canonical attribute runs. Valid rows always have the real default pattern;run clipping,index union,unsigned keys,idempotent insertion,existing attributes and holder destruction are retained. Conditional copy orchestration,style migration,painting and full paste history remain unverified. Task76 conditional-index removal binds actual document/table/column/attribute owners:zero clears all indices while retaining an explicit empty item;nonzero erases only the first matching index,including initializer-list duplicates. Existing attributes survive,and table removal clamps to allocated columns without allocating a new tail. Scalar SetValue and literal SetTextCell bodies are partitioned onto the same actual owners in column3/documen7;native defaults,stores,listener order and text admission are unchanged. Full conditional copy/style migration and paste/history remain pending. Task76 native UndoToColumn/UndoToTable restore the edited payload,formula-only cells outside its rows/columns,whole conditional-format ownership,and full-axis raw geometry/manual breaks with actual null geometry checks. Marked copying retains the original null-mark-data asymmetry (CALC-265). Real table5 page/manual sets,ordered set value/move binding,stream-validity state/document locking and width-change pagination invalidation are represented. Named-expression maps,pagination/device calculation,full XML streaming and native document-level Undo/paste/history orchestration remain unported;no fake owner or alternate workbook is introduced.
